question: How many tiers make up Nigeria's healthcare delivery system?
explanation: You've got this! Nigeria runs on a simple three-tier system: primary, secondary, and tertiary levels, making sure care reaches everywhere from local villages to big cities. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h1)

question: Which level of government in Nigeria is mainly in charge of running primary health facilities?
explanation: Spot on! Local government councils take the lead in managing primary health care centers so they stay close and accessible to community members. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h1)

question: What is the main job of a health post in the Nigerian PHC system?

options.B: Basic health education and first aid

explanation: Think of a health post as your friendly neighborhood first point of contact—great for basic health talks, first aid, and simple wellness tips! [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h2)

question: A pregnant woman in a rural village visits her nearest primary health center. What kind of care will she get there?

options.C: Routine antenatal care and normal delivery

explanation: Exactly! Primary health centers are well-equipped to support mothers through routine antenatal visits and safe, normal deliveries right in their communities. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h2)

question: Where do secondary health facilities usually receive their admitted patients from?
explanation: You got it! When a patient needs more care than a primary health center can offer, they get referred up to a secondary facility like a general hospital. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h3)

question: Which of these is a typical example of a secondary healthcare center in Nigeria?
explanation: Nice work! General hospitals and state specialist hospitals make up the secondary tier, offering admission wards and doctors with specific clinical skills. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h3)

question: What sets tertiary health facilities apart from secondary ones?

options.A: Provision of highly specialized care and medical training
options.B: Focus exclusively on immunization and health talks
options.C: Management strictly by local government councils
options.D: Restriction of services to emergency outpatient care

explanation: Spot on! Tertiary centers take things a step further by offering advanced sub-specialty care, cutting-edge research, and training for medical and nursing students. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h4)

question: Which of these is a tertiary healthcare facility?
explanation: You nailed it! University teaching hospitals are top-tier centers where complex medical cases are handled and future health professionals are trained. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h4)

question: Who do nurses usually team up with in hospitals to provide social and welfare support for patients?
explanation: That's right! Medical social workers are wonderful partners who help nurses tackle the financial, emotional, and social challenges facing our patients. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h5)

question: A patient finishes surgery but cannot afford their hospital bill or medications. Who is the best person to help them find a way out?
explanation: Exactly! Medical social workers specialize in connecting struggling patients with financial aid, charity support, and community resources. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h5)

question: What do we call the transfer of a stable patient from a big tertiary hospital back to a primary health center?
explanation: Great job! A 'downward referral' simply means sending a recovering patient closer to home for routine follow-up care at a primary center. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h6)

question: Why is a formal referral letter so important when moving a patient between hospitals?

options.A: To provide clinical history and treatment details for continuity
options.B: To replace the need for physical nursing assessment
options.C: To guarantee immediate employment for the patient
options.D: To serve as a financial receipt for hospital services

explanation: Spot on! A referral letter tells the receiving team what has already been done, ensuring the patient's care continues smoothly without missing a beat. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h6)

question: What is the main focus of nursing practice at the primary healthcare level?
explanation: You've got this! Primary care nurses spend a lot of time educating communities, giving immunizations, and stopping sickness before it starts. [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h7)

question: How do a nurse's daily duties usually change when moving from a general hospital to a tertiary teaching hospital?

options.A: They stop caring for patients entirely to focus on accounting
options.B: They only perform basic first aid duties outdoors
options.C: They often become more specialized and technologically focused
options.D: They relinquish all administrative and leadership duties

explanation: Correct! Tertiary hospitals expose you to advanced machines, complex disease cases, and high-tech nursing sub-specialties. It's an exciting learning curve! [learn more](GNS112_U2_T2#GNS112_U2_T2_h7)
